name: Dharavi Slum Tours and Travel
description:
Dharavi Slum Tour offers an authentic, ethical, and guided walking tour of Dharavi, Mumbai, one of Asia’s largest and most dynamic communities. Our tours focus on real stories, local industries, culture, and everyday life, providing visitors with a deeper understanding beyond stereotypes.

Led by knowledgeable local guides, the Dharavi Slum Tour highlights small-scale industries, including pottery, recycling, leather work, garment production, food making units, and community enterprises that contribute millions to Mumbai’s economy. We also share insights into education, social structure, resilience, and traditional lifestyles within Dharavi.

featured_reviews.name: 光頭小伍
featured_reviews.review_text:
走進孟買的心臟，你會來到一個讓世界又震撼又敬佩的地方——Dharavi。這裡面積僅約1.75平方公里，卻容納了數十萬人口，是亞洲最密集的社區之一。但如果你只用「貧民窟」來定義它，那就太小看這裡了。

在狹窄巷弄之間，藏著驚人的經濟能量。回收、皮革、紡織、陶器，一間間小工坊日夜運轉，創造出數億美元的產值，產品甚至銷往世界各地。這裡沒有華麗辦公室，卻有最真實的創業精神；沒有資源優勢，卻用雙手打造無限可能。

來自印度各地的人們在此落腳，不同語言、宗教與文化交織，形成獨特的生命力。儘管面對擁擠與衛生挑戰，他們依然努力生活、努力工作，用韌性撐起整個城市的運轉。

達拉維不是悲情的象徵，而是一面鏡子，讓人看見人在困境中依然可以發光。走一趟，你會重新理解什麼叫做努力，什麼叫做希望。
featured_reviews.review_translated_text:
Step into the heart of Mumbai, and you'll find a place that both shocks and inspires awe—Dharavi. Spanning only about 1.75 square kilometers, it houses hundreds of thousands of people, making it one of the most densely populated communities in Asia. But to define it merely as a "slum" would be a gross underestimation.

Hidden within its narrow alleyways is an astonishing economic energy. Recycling, leather, textiles, pottery—small workshops operate day and night, generating hundreds of millions of dollars in revenue, with products sold worldwide. Here, there are no glamorous offices, but the most genuine entrepreneurial spirit; no resource advantages, but limitless possibilities created with their own hands.

People from all over India have settled here, their diverse languages, religions, and cultures intertwining to create a unique vitality. Despite facing overcrowding and sanitation challenges, they persevere, working hard and resiliently keeping the city running.

Dharavi is not a symbol of tragedy, but a mirror reflecting the light that shines even in adversity. A visit will give you a new understanding of the meaning of hard work and hope.

featured_reviews.name: avalon facilty
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had booking on 24th & 25th Jan'26 for 7 people.Worst Tour Experience – Very Disappointing

Our Mahabaleshwar tour turned out to be a very bad experience overall. The food quality was below average and did not meet basic expectations. Even basic amenities were missing in the hotel room—there was no Bisleri drinking water provided, and despite repeated requests, we were not given proper soap, shampoo, or a kettle.
Hotel name Hillview

The hotel in-charge was unfriendly and uncooperative. He did not respond properly to our concerns and refused to provide essentials like drinking water.

The bus service was very poor, and the sightseeing arrangements were not up to the mark at all. On the second day, the hotel provided a car for sightseeing for only 2 hours, after which we were left idle inside the hotel for the entire day with nothing to do. This completely ruined our trip.

To make matters worse, they didn’t even provide a car to drop us back to the bus stop for our return journey, which caused a lot of inconvenience with my 2 year toddler.

Overall, this was a highly disappointing and poorly managed tour. I would not recommend this hotel or tour service to anyone.

featured_reviews.name: Prashant Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
This temple is the perfect destination if you are looking to feel relaxed, calm, and deeply connected to the supreme lord. From the moment you arrive, the vibe is incredibly positive and uplifting, creating a truly serene atmosphere.
One of the highlights is the continuous bhajans (devotional songs) that echo throughout the space, making it easy to leave your worries behind and find a sense of peace.
Beyond the spiritual experience, the temple complex is well-equipped with other amenities. There is a bookshop for those interested in spiritual texts, a food court for casual dining, and the excellent Govinda's restaurant for a more complete meal.
If you want to spend quality time in a calm, peaceful, and spiritually charged environment, this is the best place to be. I highly recommend it.

featured_reviews.name: Subrata Roy
featured_reviews.review_text: A beautiful and peaceful temple dedicated to Radha and Krishna. The atmosphere at Radha Giridhari Temple ISKCON is very spiritual and calming. The kirtans, aartis, and overall devotion make the experience truly divine. The temple is very clean and well maintained. A perfect place to find peace and connect with Krishna. Hare Krishna! 🙏✨

featured_reviews.name: vijay wadia
featured_reviews.review_text:
This is another beautiful ISKON temple in Miraroad.
Built in a limited space so the temple is small as compared to Juhu ISKON.
As we visited on public holiday there was huge crowd. The management was poor and crowd control was not there.
There was shoes all over the temple premises.
The idol of Radha Krishna was very preety and beautiful ❤️.
They also have idol of Shree Jagannath of Puri.
They have sweets outlet.
There was a light snacks counters served chinese, South Indian dishes, and chat etc.
Better to visit during working day and off time to avoid crowd.
There was no parking as we have to park car on street.

featured_reviews.name: TANMAY CHOUGULE
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited the ISKCON Mira Road Temple and the temple itself is beautiful with a very peaceful and spiritual atmosphere. It is a wonderful place for prayer, meditation, and spending quiet time.

However, I was very disappointed with the behaviour of the security staff. A place like a temple should reflect kindness, patience, and respect. Unfortunately, some security guards were using harsh language with devotees, especially elderly people, and even pushing them while managing the crowd. This kind of behaviour is not appropriate in a spiritual place where people come seeking peace.

I hope the temple management looks into this matter and trains the security staff to treat devotees with more respect and compassion. The temple environment is lovely, but the behaviour of the security staff needs serious improvement.

featured_reviews.name: Vinod Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text: The Shri Radhagiridhari Temple is a peaceful and spiritually uplifting place in Mira Road, Clean surroundings and well-organized management add to the overall experience, making it a must-visit for devotees and anyone seeking inner peace.

featured_reviews.name: jayshetye
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visiting ISKCON Mira Road Temple was a truly peaceful and heart-touching experience. The divine atmosphere, beautiful temple architecture, and soulful chanting filled my heart with positivity and devotion.

The moment I entered the temple, I felt a sense of calm and spiritual connection that is difficult to describe in words. The devotees’ dedication and the serene environment make this place a perfect escape from the stress of daily life.

I left with a grateful heart and a peaceful mind. Thank you, ISKCON Mira Road, for providing such a divine and uplifting experience. Hare Krishna! 🙏✨

featured_reviews.name: Nrusingha Sahu
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visiting ISKCON Temple, Mira Road was truly a divine and peaceful experience. The moment I entered the temple, I felt surrounded by positive energy and serenity. The atmosphere is so calm, pure, and spiritually uplifting.
The temple is beautifully maintained, and the devotees and staff are very humble, kind, and always ready to help. The kirtans and prayers create an aura of devotion that touches the heart deeply.
It’s a perfect place to connect with the divine and find inner peace amidst the chaos of daily life.
Truly, ISKCON Mira Road is not just a temple — it’s a spiritual home for every soul. 🙏💫
